note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Voluntary turnover among our warehouse staff rose from 18% to 27% last year.

answers.common.decision: Whether to change shift scheduling policy for warehouse staff; the HR director decides, and any decision about an individual stays with their manager and HR.
answers.common.deadline: The HR leadership meeting next month.
answers.common.audience: The HR director and the operations director.
answers.common.materials: We employ 400 warehouse staff. Replacing one costs about $6,000 in hiring and training. In exit surveys, 54 leavers named shift scheduling as their main reason.
answers.data-analytics.data: Headcount and leaver records for warehouse staff and exit survey answers, by group, not by name.
answers.data-analytics.question: Why warehouse turnover rose and what it costs.
